title: Japanese-Style Dashi Tofu Stir Fry
description: A simple and savory Chinese-inspired stir fry dish made with Japanese dashi broth and pan-seared tofu.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add another tablespoon of oil and stir-fry the mushrooms until they're tender.
Pour in the dashi broth and bring to a simmer.
Return the tofu to the wok and add the soy sauce and chili flakes (if using). Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped dates and cook for 30 seconds.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
